detail: Type 'Z' is not defined in ITCH 5.0. Because the 2-byte prefix carries the length independently of the type table, this IS recoverable: consume the 20 declared bytes, count the message as unknown, and continue framing. A decoder that aborts here cannot tolerate a future Nasdaq message type. A decoder that skips a number of bytes taken from its type table rather than from the prefix will desynchronise.
correct_behaviour: skip exactly 20 bytes, increment an unknown-type counter, continue; do NOT raise
